title: Detailed teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Shadow/ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="30" ry="4" fill="#2a2a4a"/>

  <!-- Spout -->
  <path d="M72 45 Q82 40 84 30 Q85 26 82 25 Q79 24 77 27 Q75 32 70 36" fill="#e8553a" stroke="#ff8060" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M72 47 Q80 44 82 36 Q83 32 81 31 Q79 30 78 33 Q77 38 71 41" fill="#ff7a5a" stroke="#ffb090" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d="M26 42 Q12 42 10 55 Q8 68 22 72" fill="none" stroke="#e8553a" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M26 42 Q12 42 10 55 Q8 68 22 72" fill="none" stroke="#ff9a7a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="28" ry="26" fill="#e8553a"/>
  <path d="M24 55 Q24 40 42 36 Q50 34 58 36 Q76 40 76 55" fill="#ff7a5a"/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="24" ry="21" fill="none" stroke="#ff9a7a" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Lid base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="20" ry="6" fill="#d94430"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="35" rx="20" ry="6" fill="#ff6a4a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="35" rx="17" ry="4.5" fill="#ff8a6a"/>

  <!-- Lid dome -->
  <path d="M34 34 Q34 22 50 20 Q66 22 66 34" fill="#ff6a4a"/>
  <path d="M37 33 Q37 24 50 22 Q63 24 63 33" fill="#ff9a7a"/>

  <!-- Knob -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="19" r="4" fill="#ffb090"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="19" r="2.5" fill="#ffd0b8"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="18" r="1" fill="#fff0e8"/>

  <!-- Decorative band -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="27" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc44" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="27" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#ffe880" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Decorative dots on band -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#ffe880"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="48.5" r="1.8" fill="#ffe880"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="1.8" fill="#ffe880"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="48.5" r="1.8" fill="#ffe880"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#ffe880"/>

  <!-- Lower band -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc44" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="72" r="1.3" fill="#ffe880"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="73" r="1.3" fill="#ffe880"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="72" r="1.3" fill="#ffe880"/>

  <!-- Base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="16" ry="4" fill="#d94430"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="83" rx="16" ry="4" fill="#e8553a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82.5" rx="13" ry="3" fill="#ff7a5a"/>

  <!-- Shine on body -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="50" rx="6" ry="12" fill="#ffb090" opacity="0.5" transform="rotate(-15 40 50)"/>
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="48" rx="2.5" ry="7" fill="#ffd0b8" opacity="0.6" transform="rotate(-15 39 48)"/>

  <!-- Spout opening highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="82.5" cy="27" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#ffb090" transform="rotate(-30 82.5 27)"/>
</svg>
